actions.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /app
if command -v qemu-system-x86_64 >/dev/null 2>&1; then QEMU=qemu-system-x86_64; elif command -v qemu-system-i386 >/dev/null 2>&1; then QEMU=qemu-system-i386; else echo 'NO_QEMU'; exit 1; fi
printf 'QEMU=%s\n' "$QEMU"
file alpine.iso || true
file alpine-disk.qcow2 || true
